newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Taleban proclaim Islamic system in Afghanistan.
newsitem.headline: Taleban proclaim Islamic system in Afghanistan.

text.p: Afghanistan's Taleban Islamic militia said on Friday it had taken control of the capital Kabul and declared it would enforce an Islamic system in the country.

A statement by the movement's supreme leader Mullah Omar, quoted by the Pakistan-based Afghan news service, declared Afghanistan a "completely Islamic state" where it said a "complete Islamic system will be enforced". It did not elaborate.

The Afghan Islamic Press news agency said Omar, who is based in the southern Afghan town of Kandahar, had suspended all Afghan ambassadors in foreign countries, ordered them not to spend any government money and asked countries where they were accredited not to deal with them.
The news agency quoted Omar as urging Kabul citizens not to leave their homes and asking those who had left to return. He said the Taleban would guarantee their lives and property.
Omar urged the country's traders to ensure supplies of food and other commodities to the population.
The agencys aid he also appealed to organisations engaged in clearing landmines in the war-torn country to clear all roads leading to Kabul.
